ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 35:65 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two primary high-intensity contiguous regions are mapped to the distal-superior quadrants of the left and right lobes. These regions exhibit irregular, feathered boundaries. The central, proximal, and inferior sections consist of low-intensity pixels characterized by high-density, fine-grain stippling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow U-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 24 degrees at the base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations detected along the full trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the lateral segments of both lobes, transitioning to smoother, lower-amplitude variations near the central notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The outer distal edges follow a convex curve, while the trailing edges follow a bimodal concave sweep from the lateral tips converging at the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct, high-contrast circular pixel clusters (consistent with barnacle colonization) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of dark, roughly vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are detected within the high-intensity pigmentation zone on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of parasitic attachment scars at the lateral tips; scattered micro-rosette white scars distributed across the central low-intensity field.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense, uniform white stippling (speckle pattern) is present across all low-intensity (black) regions of the fluke's ventral surface.
